body:
Fixes #427

The integration step ignored every `loom optimize` error with `|| true` and treated missing output as a skip. This runs the command under strict shell error handling, writes its output into a fresh temporary directory, and requires a nonempty artifact. Optimizer failures and missing output now fail the step, and stale files on self-hosted runners cannot create a false pass.

The CLI supports `.wat` input directly, so the workflow does not need a runner-dependent skip.

Validation:
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` passed.
- The workflow YAML parsed successfully; manual Bash checks confirmed command failures and missing output exit nonzero.
- `cargo test --all` could not complete on Windows because `z3-sys` bindgen could not find `libclang.dll`; the Linux CI suite should provide the full test result.

Assisted by Codex.
title: Make the optimizer integration check fail on errors
